title: fix(components): a long unbroken token keeps the alert dialog inside max-w-lg, with its buttons on screen
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDJAbBe3iTrFcF7GZrucZ32)_

Fixes #37761

The record delete confirm puts the record's title into the alert dialog's title. A title holding one long token with no spaces (a pasted URL, a file name, a hash) stretched the dialog past the viewport, and Cancel and Delete went off-screen, reachable only from the keyboard.

## Premise, measured

`AlertDialogContent` is `grid w-full max-w-lg … p-6` with one `auto` column track; `AlertDialogTitle` (`text-lg font-semibold`) and `AlertDialogDescription` (`text-sm text-muted-foreground`) carry no wrap rule, and nothing sets `min-w-0`. So the token's min-content width became the track's width.

Chromium at 1440 px, the component's own class strings compiled by Tailwind 4.3.3, a 5,000-character token in the title:

| | dialog client width | dialog scroll width | title `overflow-wrap` | Cancel x | Delete right edge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `main` | 510 px | 51,248 px | `normal` | 51,540 | 51,713 |
| this PR | 510 px | 510 px | `anywhere` | 778 | 951 |

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/components` (`ui/alert-dialog.tsx`), the shared component, so every alert dialog is covered:**
  - `AlertDialogContent` adds `[&>*]:min-w-0`: each grid item may shrink below its min-content width, so no child can widen the track past `max-w-lg`.
  - `AlertDialogTitle` and `AlertDialogDescription` add `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`: a token wider than the dialog breaks instead of overflowing. The full text stays in the dialog, wrapped.

## Decisions made here

- **Wrap, not truncate.** The acceptance allows either; wrapping keeps the whole title readable with no tooltip, and a confirm is read before a destructive click.
- **`overflow-wrap: anywhere`, not `break-words`.** `break-word` does not lower an element's min-content width, so in an `auto` grid track the token would still set the width; `anywhere` does.
- **Declared as shadcn local patches.** `src/ui/alert-dialog.tsx` is vendored; the three edits are declared in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` (`alertDialogLongTokenPatches`, anchored on `alert-dialog.registry.txt`) so the file still regenerates from registry bytes. The first head (`6e50306d80`) edited the file without them and went red on Test UI 1/16 (`shadcn-local-patches`: "alert-dialog.tsx no longer regenerates from registry bytes"); the second commit declares them and moves the reasons out of inline comments into the declarations.
- **Arbitrary-value classes** (`[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`, `[&>*]:min-w-0`) rather than v4-only named utilities, as the repo has no precedent for `wrap-anywhere` yet.
- **`Dialog` is not changed.** The card and its measurement are the alert dialog; no regular dialog was measured.

## Verification

- `components/src/__tests__/alert-dialog-long-token-37761.test.tsx` (4): the content carries `[&>*]:min-w-0` beside `grid w-full max-w-lg`; the title and description carry `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` with a 5,000-character token rendered; a caller's own classes still merge (tailwind-merge drops `text-lg` for `text-xl`) and the wrap rule stays; both buttons render. 3 of 4 are red with `alert-dialog.tsx` reverted (the button control is green on both). jsdom does no layout, so the pixel numbers above come from the Chromium measurement, not this test.
- `vitest` over all of `@object-ui/components` (512 files, 4,969 passed, including the critical snapshots): green. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`: 87 passed after the second commit.
- `overlap-check`: exit 0.
